component.name: Serat
component.summary: Markdown notes in a plain folder

description.p: Serat is a native note-taking app for folders of Markdown files. It reads and writes the same vault layout as other Markdown note apps, so notes stay plain text you can open anywhere.

ul.li: Live preview editing with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, tables, math and diagrams
Backlinks, unlinked mentions, tags, bookmarks, outline and a graph of your notes
Fast search across thousands of notes
Spellcheck, file recovery, export to PDF and HTML
